articles.title: OCC calls on community banks to enter the stablecoin payments market
articles.snippet: The U.S. banking regulator is encouraging smaller lenders to develop stablecoin services as new federal licensing requirements approach.

articles.title: Canada opens consultation on draft stablecoin rules, maintains ban on yields
articles.snippet: Under the draft rules, non-bank stablecoin issuers must back tokens 1:1 with reserves held at qualified Canadian institutions and settle redemptions within three business days.

articles.title: Calpers pulls back from big tech as AI jitters deepen neocloud sell-off
articles.snippet: California’s pension fund shifts toward private equity as investors question tech valuations and the payoff from soaring AI spending.

articles.title: Canada opens consultation on stablecoins, citing US GENIUS Act
articles.snippet: As part of the potential implementation of its Stablecoin Act, the Canadian government will hear from the public on a proposed framework for tokens from non-financial institutions.

articles.title: Securitize’s tokenized stock value halves as Circle widens lead
articles.snippet: SECZ’s onchain market cap fell to $208.6 million as Circle-linked tokens reached a combined $383.6 million across several issuers in the $3.3 billion tokenized equities market.
